title: B01 groundwater reduced-dynamics closure qualification
primary_research_question: Can the published multi-layer LARE closure propagate a reduced storage state that is already shown to be information-sufficient, without introducing hydrologically consequential closure error?

separation_of_errors.state_information_error: measured by RS1/P1/P2C before any reduced dynamics
separation_of_errors.closure_error: difference introduced by published LARE propagation from the same projected state
separation_of_errors.coarse_richards_discretization_error: difference introduced by conventional Richards discretization on the same fixed layer geometry
separation_of_errors.time_integration_error: measured separately by temporal refinement of each reduced dynamics route

mandatory_routes.role: closure-resolution control with no demonstrated extra RS1 state-information value

conditional_route.authorization_condition: Standard published LARE first demonstrates a reproducible hydrostatic/equilibrium preservation defect that is attributable to the published closure rather than implementation error.

gates: mass-conservative layer ledger to machine-scale accounting

stage_order.input_states: response-blind subset of existing Stage-A Reference states, selected before LARE response

stage_order.purpose: frozen future-probe propagation from P2C state cohort
stage_order.cohort: the same 41 response-blind P2 common-cohort states where route initialization is physically defined

purpose_outputs: CPU and function-evaluation counts only after physical qualification

state_vs_closure: If D3 state information is sufficient but LARE_D3 fails while CR_D3 succeeds, classify closure-method failure.
If both LARE_D3 and CR_D3 fail similarly, classify coarse vertical resolution as the likely limiting factor before attributing failure specifically to LARE.
If LARE_D4 materially improves over LARE_D3 while P2C shows D3 and D4 state-information equivalence, classify the gain as closure-resolution benefit rather than missing state information.

If LARE_D3 succeeds while CR_D3 is worse under the same purpose vector, this supports a scientific advantage of integrated layer averaging over conventional coarse Richards at equal prognostic dimension.
If D2 fails where D3 succeeds, preserve that as evidence for a minimum information requirement rather than tuning D2.
adjudication_logic.application_acceptance: No absolute GW-D/GW-R ACCEPT_FOR_PURPOSE claim until an external application envelope or downstream coupling sensitivity authority exists.
adjudication_logic.computational_value: No speedup claim until physical qualification passes; compare wall time and evaluation counts only for scientifically admissible routes.

no_fit_rule: No closure coefficient, empirical correction, learned term, clipping threshold or flux correction may be fitted to Reference response in RD1.
conservation_rule: No correction flux may hide closure drift. Any numerical projection correction must be reported separately and cannot enter the water ledger as a physical flux.
state_publication_rule: Any future SWAP solver integration must publish a valid full physical state through the existing solver contract, but RD1 may remain a research harness until the closure survives.
